miniProject.title: Restart-safe clocks, membership and fenced authority
miniProject.brief: Extend `loglab` with clocks, durable actor identities, heartbeat detectors, gossip membership and a fenced lease service. Replay deterministic schedules on your machine before any timing run, keeping membership convergence separate from exclusive authority and naming the assumptions needed for progress.
steps: Add injectable wall and monotonic clocks in `clock/`, with skew, drift, jumps and uncertainty intervals. Check Lamport stamps, vector comparisons and per-key dotted versions against an independently constructed happens-before graph and causal event sets; retain concurrency, context-subsumption and member-replacement fixtures.

Implement HLC updates and restart-safe IDs with durable clock pairs and identity epochs. Check HLC transitions against the paper's Figure 5 and IDs against a set oracle across restart and dual-incarnation schedules; retain bound-violation alerts and separate Gossip Glomers Unique ID Generation results.

Build configurable fixed-threshold and \(\phi\) accrual detectors in `member/`. Replay recorded arrivals under delay, observer and peer pauses, overload, burst loss and partitions; compare suspicion decisions with independent distribution calculations, defining startup and deviation floors, and retain seeds and ground-truth liveness labels.

Implement bounded gossip dissemination using `net/`. Check fixed schedules against a set-union convergence oracle, then pass Gossip Glomers Broadcast through its partition challenge under Maelstrom; retain run directories and explain duplicate contacts relative to the no-repeat rumor-growth model without claiming ordering or durability.

Add versioned membership views with join, leave and fresh-identity replacement. Compare reordered Suspect, Alive and Confirm transitions with an independent original-SWIM transition table; retain stale-view and incarnation tests, terminal-report handling and seeds, explicitly separating gossip views from authority configurations.

Implement lease acquire, renew and release with owner-token checks and durable resource-side fencing. Against a sequential grant model, test expiry, pauses, delayed renewal, partitions and restart; retain stale writes before and after token installation, the activation boundary and a fixed-configuration majority-authority fixture.

Extend campaigns with asymmetric reachability, correlated failures, clock jumps, split-brain attempts and healing; assert fencing after every transition and retain identical replays plus a minimized failure. After correctness gates, compare detector delay against false suspicion across thresholds and windows; report repeated gossip-convergence and traffic measurements.
deliverables: The `clock/` and `member/` components, deterministic timer integration, restart-safe identity contract and resource-side fencing boundary.
Causal and transition oracles, replayable fault histories, public-suite results and a minimized regression with seeds and explicit schedules.
Detector trade-off curves and gossip cost report from retained traces, separating simulated progress from process timings and authority guarantees.

checks.name: Gossip Glomers 2: Unique ID Generation
checks.note: Keep Maelstrom results separately; your restart and dual-incarnation tests establish guarantees this network-only challenge does not check.

checks.name: Gossip Glomers 3a to 3c: Broadcast
checks.note: Run the single-node, multi-node and partition challenges; retain raw histories without treating their convergence checks as ordering or membership-authority tests.

rubric.pass: Own graph and event-set oracles validate clocks, concurrency and dotted-context replacement. Figure 5 checks validate HLC cases; restart and dual-incarnation tests catch reused identities independently of Maelstrom.
rubric.strong: Planted clock-state loss and dot-subsumption defects fail before repair; out-of-envelope resets explicitly delimit the normal causality guarantee.

rubric.pass: Own fixed-trace decisions match independent distribution calculations. Curves count live-peer false-suspicion episodes and crash-to-suspicion delay separately, with consistent warmup and retained seeds, versions and arrival traces.
rubric.strong: Repeated matched comparisons retain a model-mismatch regime; observer-pause guards are tested without claiming they detect remote pauses or prove death.

rubric.pass: Own transition-table tests cover stale reports and replacement; set-union checks establish convergence under stated delivery assumptions. Sequential grant checks and durable resource fences reject backward tokens after activation despite incorrect suspicion.
rubric.strong: A planted stale-view or fence-persistence defect yields a minimized regression; traces explain why a pre-installation stale write is not retroactively fenced.

rubric.pass: Own replay diffs are empty for retained schedules; per-transition safety checks precede repeated timing runs with versions and workloads. Reports separate simulated ticks, process measurements, bounded non-progress and conditional convergence.
rubric.strong: The minimized counterexample preserves the violated predicate and environmental assumptions; correlated and asymmetric faults expose a gap missed by independent-node campaigns.

miniProject.feedsInto: Restart-safe actors, dotted contexts, detector traces, versioned gossip views and fenced-resource fixtures feed replication, consensus, shard ownership and consumer groups; the capstone inherits replayable clock and authority failures with explicit safety and progress assumptions.
